title: BERGSHULT / KROKSHULT wall shelf
description: BERGSHULT / KROKSHULT wall shelf, walnut effect/anthracite, 311/2x113/4" With this wall shelf, you can use your empty walls to display your things. Use it in the bedroom, as a sideboard in the living room, a display shelf by the dining table – or whatever you decide.
features: The shelf carries a max. of 22 lbs when properly mounted on the wall.
Max. load refers to the max. weight before the shelf is risking to slant. Distribute the weight evenly on the shelf to avoid the risk of slanting.
If you are uncertain about what type of mounting devices to use, please contact your local hardware store.
Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
materialAndCare: Particleboard, Paper foil, Plastic edging, Plastic edging; Steel, Steel, Epoxy/polyester powder coating
